summary: book-3 (chapters I-XI, 1648 leaves 126-194, printed pp. 103-171): 183 findings -- wording 102, scripture 69, slip 8, omission 3, reference 1, margin 0. Every leaf 126-194 was read on the page image, and each row's goold text occurs exactly once in its .typ file. Notes: (1) No margin rows: Book III's margins carry only section marks (§I, §II ...) and argument numbers, with no captions. The one margin gloss with words (Aufert, sustulit, ipse bajulabit, tulit; chap. IX) became a Goold footnote that drops 'ipse bajulabit', and is listed as wording. (2) Head numbering: 1648 numbers the arguments 1-8, then 10 and 11 (it has no 9), against Goold's IX and X; chapters V-VII, X and XI carry no argument number in 1648 (Goold added Arg. XI-XVI); in chap. IX, 1648 sets 'Arg. 5' a paragraph early; in chap. VIII Goold reordered and renumbered Owen's answers 2ly/3ly and 5ly/6ly and added (7.). Each is its own wording row, editor's call. (3) Rows starting MISPRINT? have proposed = Goold: this a condition, confusedly/confessedly, them that have who, oblation and was, confined/confirmed, Where/whence, 1000/ten thousand talents, bear/bare, damnation/dominion of sin, satisfaction/justification, Yea/Ye; 'commended his life' in Rom. v. 8 (an early hand corrects it to 'love' in this copy) is in the same scripture row. (4) Clear CCEL slips: 'be' for 'he' three times, 'its' for 'us', 'decrees' for 'degrees', 'not he not', 'but any time' for 'at any time'; 'cases' for 'causes' is less sure. (5) Many Scripture quotations are Owen's own wording, which Goold replaced with the KJV's (Matt. xi. 25-26, Rom. xi. 7, Heb. ii. 15, Lev. v. 1, 2 Cor. v. 21, John xv. 13, Jas. iv. 12, etc.). (6) Not listed: Goold's bracketed insertions, viz./namely, unto/to in prose, hath/doth kept, and Goold's corrected references, apart from one reference row for the chap. II list, where he added verses.
